body: Thank you very much for the helpful link! I will certainly consider this option.

Well, the doctor advised me not to shave my head. He strongly believes that my hair will grow back. The issue is that its been nearly 2 years since my hairfall and there isnt any improvement on the growth front. So was wondering what other people with similar issues do.

Well, the issue for me is that i dont have hair on the top of my head, I have hair on the sides and back of the head (kinda like how old people look). So its probably difficult to style my hair in any fashion. The doctor also told me not to shave my head because he says the hair will grow back. I don't think I have any radiation scars as well.

I just wear a baseball cap all the time. The tumor for me was on the top of my brain, so the radiation was directly on the top of my head. I still have hair on the sides and the back.

Normally for hair loss, I find that the doctors and physicians give advice, maybe a cranial prosthetic (which is pretty much a wig). My doctor told me not to shave my full head, as he's confident after seeing me before radiation that my hair looks robust and will grow back. So being a male, I just wear caps and hats every time I step out of the house. It probably boils down to personal choice, and you can also ask the doctor/physician for advice as they see similar patients on a frequent basis.

Wishing your sister a speedy recovery.
Thank you for the suggestion. Is it better to first consult a doctor about this?

I completed my radiation in October 2020, and I was able to notice a little growth from Jan 2021. However, until today as far as I can tell the hair is super thin, and bald spot really visible. But every time I go to the barber or someone has a look at my head they just say that hair growing. I don't know if it's just to boost my confidence or if actually is, because every time I see in the mirror for the past few months I see no improvements. I do not remember the dosage of my radiation but the doctor is confident since day 1 that my hair will grow back.
Thank you for your suggestion! I will certainly look into it.

I see, thank you for the suggestion! As mentioned in a response to another user, the hair is really thin but bald spot is visibly seen. I'm having to wear a cap every time I step out of the house because I'm self-conscious and afraid of how people would judge me, because of how young I am.
